description: User-level guards for OpenAI Codex (~/.codex/hooks.json). Copy the scripts to ~/.codex/hooks/ first, then trust the hooks with /hooks. Codex parses permissionDecision 'ask' but does not support it (the call proceeds), so guards that would ask run with --codex and block with exit 2 instead. File-edit guards (guard-paths, format-on-save, check-version-decrease) are Claude-only: Codex edits through apply_patch, whose input has no file_path.
